reading.body:
This building at 5414 Tulane Road sits within the xAI Colossus supercomputer campus in Memphis, Tennessee, adjacent to the separately tracked Colossus 2 facility roughly 500 meters away. Industry aggregator data describes it as a $659 million, 312,000-square-foot expansion project, distinct from the original Colossus 1 building on Riverport Road. No independent confirmation of this building's completion date, power capacity, or current occupancy was located.

xAI's Memphis campus as a whole reached approximately 230,000 GPUs by mid-2025, a mix of H100, H200, and GB200 units, with a stated goal of 1 million GPUs across the full campus. The Whitehaven-area property acquisition announced in March 2025 included plans for 110,000 additional GB200 GPUs in a second data center. Whether this specific $659 million building is part of that acquisition or represents a further expansion phase was not confirmed in available sources.

The campus has drawn regulatory attention over supplemental power generation, with Colossus 1 requiring 35 gas turbines totaling 422 MW after its original 150 MW grid connection proved insufficient, triggering scrutiny over nitrogen oxide emissions and water usage. This specific building's grid connection capacity and any associated generation requirements are not published. Tennessee has 24 mapped data center facilities total, of which only four publish power figures; this campus ranks fifth by published megawatts in the state.
